title: Chiang Mai Enduro Riders Tracks
subtitle: Beginner-friendly enduro GPX routes around Chiang Mai
restricted: Please ride these community tracks instead of Doi Suthep or Hang Dong, which are restricted areas.
noRide: Red striped area on the map: Doi Suthep-Pui National Park. No off-road riding there.
shareNotice: The GPX files are for the local enduro community and shouldn't be reshared or published on other public sites.
riskNotice: Ride at your own risk. Tracks change with weather, landslides and logging, and may cross private land. Check conditions and ride with others.
contribute: Found a change on a track? Open the track and use "Send it to us".

groupTip.title: Riding as a group? Share your live location
items: WhatsApp: in the group chat, Location → Share live location → 8 hours.
Google Maps: Location sharing → pick the riders → Until you turn this off.
Messenger: in the group chat, Location → Share live location. It stops after about 1 hour, so share again.
groupTip.note: Sharing uses your phone's battery and data. Turn it off when you get home.

footer: Built and maintained by Chu. Comments and ideas: {email}
footNote: These tracks are provided for the personal use of the local riding community. Redistribution, republication or sale on other websites is not permitted.

sections.title: Easy Enduro
sections.intro: Easy GPS tracks for beginners. All are outside national parks and not restricted, except the Mae Khanin river loop, which is closed during smoke season. You might be stopped by rangers.
